mil7.3.3:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, bījassa dve angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni dve angāni gahetabbānīti. Yathā mahārāja bījaṃ appakam-pi samānaṃ bhaddake khette vuttaṃ deve sammā dhāraṃ pavecchante subahūni phalāni anudassati, evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena yathā paṭipāditaṃ sīlaṃ kevalaṃ sāmaññaphalam-anudassati evaṃ sammā paṭipajjitabbaṃ. Idaṃ mahārāja bījassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.3.3:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja bījaṃ suparisodhite khette ropitaṃ khippam-eva saṃvirūhati, evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena mānasaṃ supariggahītaṃ suññāgāre parisodhitaṃ satipaṭṭhāna-khettavare khittaṃ khippameva virūhati. Idaṃ mahārāja bījassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ. Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja therena Anuruddhena:
mil7.3.3:3.1: Yathā pi khette parisuddhe bījaṃ c' assa patiṭṭhitaṃ, vipulaṃ tassa phalaṃ hoti, api toseti kassakaṃ;
mil7.3.3:4.1: Tath' eva yogino cittaṃ suññāgāre visodhitaṃ satipaṭṭhānakhettamhi khippam-eva virūhatīti.
